name: Origamo Furioso
source:
Features:
3 love interests.
Music and graphics made by people famous enough to have their own Wikipedia pages.
Painstakingly and meticulously researched representation of Japanese high school life.
Length of about 3800 words total.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=4&t=16075&p=211983]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]

Parody otome game created as part of the 2012 worst visual novel ever challenge.
translation:
特点：
3爱好。
音乐和图形由足够知名的人制作，拥有自己的维基百科页面。
精心细致地研究了日本高中生活的表现。
总长度约3800字。

[来自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=4&t=16075&p=211983]引理软论坛[/url]]

模仿乙女游戏是2012年有史以来最糟糕的视觉小说挑战赛的一部分。
